before.label: Graph theory
before.learning_takeaway: Represent a simple graph’s connections with an adjacency matrix, and explain why relabeling vertices can change the matrix without changing the underlying graph.
before.card: Graph theory studies structures made of vertices and connecting edges. A graph’s drawing or numbering can change without altering its connections. An adjacency matrix provides one numerical representation, making it possible to analyze the same underlying network through different arrangements of symbols.
before.original_description: Studying networks of vertices and connecting edges.
